# Changelog

All notable changes to `gaia-agent-hello-world` are documented here, following
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/) and [SemVer](https://semver.org/).

## Unreleased

- README and module docs show a remembered conversation
  (`start_session_history()`), `close()`, a hosted model (`provider=`), and
  `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS` for tools that should ask first. No code change.

## 0.1.0

- Initial release of the Hello World reference agent.
